description: Edit a GLSL/Text DAT and immediately run the practical shader feedback loop: write or surgically replace source text, inspect the shader/output node for errors, and optionally capture a compact inline preview. Uses set_dat_content/edit_dat_content under the hood so DAT write guardrails stay consistent, and requires TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON=on plus TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1.

dat_path.description: Absolute path to the GLSL/Text DAT to edit.

error_path.description: Node to inspect for errors after the edit. Defaults to preview_path, then dat_path.

include_preview.description: Capture a compact inline preview after editing when preview_path is supplied.

mode.description: set overwrites the shader DAT; replace performs a surgical text replacement.

new_string.description: Replacement text. Required when mode is replace.

old_string.description: Substring to find. Required when mode is replace.

parent_depth.description: Upstream depth for inline-preview error inspection.

preview_path.description: TOP path to preview after the shader edit, usually the GLSL TOP output or Null TOP.

recursive_errors.description: If true, check errors recursively under error_path.

replace_all.description: For replace mode, replace all matches instead of requiring exactly one match.

shader_code.description: Full shader source. Required when mode is set.

name: edit_shader_live_loop
title: Edit shader live loop
